title: Signature UI, E-signed badge and request-signature tracker
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; A-20 and A-31 work on a real signed document, in all four theme/control combinations
notes: Shell half of the signing pair per ADR 0012; opens only after the T-0241 library is verified and its claim is released. Serves acceptance items A-20 (signature with an E-signed badge only when the cryptographic check passes on an unmodified document), A-31 (request signature by email with a tracker that updates on import of the signed copy) and A-25 (place drawn/typed/image signature appearances) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Two rounds. Round 1: place drawn, typed and image signature appearances and certificate signatures on the page, calling the T-0241 signing API, plus a signature panel that shows the verification result. Round 2: the E-signed badge gated on a passing digest of an unmodified document, the request-signature email flow and the tracker list. Calls the library and does not change its semantics. The signing feature-matrix rows become `verified` only when this task lands; until then they stay `library` after T-0241. The app lane runs one task at a time, so earlier app tasks are implicit ordering constraints, not formal dependencies.
